text:
Model	S5800P-48F-2TC
Product mame	Hybrid Gigabit uplink 48-port 100M POE switch
Fixed Port	48*10/100Base-TX PoE port（Data/Power） / 2*1000M COMBO
PoE Ports	1-48 port supports IEEE802.3af/at, max 30W/port, PoE out
PoE Pin	12+ 36-
PoE Bridge	max 600W
Bandwidth	17.6Gbps
Packet Forwarding	10.12Mpps
MAC	8K
Buffer	4.1M
Transmission Distance	10BASE-T ： Cat3,4,5 UTP(≤250 meter) / 100BASE-TX ： Cat5 or later UTP(150 meter) / 1000BASE-TX ： Cat6 or later UTP(150 meter) / SFP: 1000M single and multimode optical module with maximum distance ≤ 120km (depending on the optical module)
LED Indicator	PWR:Power LED(over-power LED) / 1-48:POE work indicator;Link_Network connection indicator / 49-50:Network connection indicator / Uplink:(Link LED=10/100M Link、1000M=Gigabit Link）Port:(Orange=PoE LED, Green=LAN Link LED）
Power	Built-in power AC：100-240Vac 50-60Hz 7.5A   max 625W
Operating Temperature/Humidity	-10～+55°C；5%～90% RH Non coagulation
Storage Temperature/Humidity	-40～+75°C；5%～95% RH Non coagulation
Product /Packing / size（L*W*H）	445mm*295mm*45mm / 515mm*375mm*95mm
N.W/G.W（kg）	4.4kg/5.1kg
Lightning / Protection  level	6KV 8/20us； / IP30
Installation	Rack-mount (optional machine hanger spare parts)
Certificate	CE-EMC EN55032；CE-LVD EN62368；
FCC Part 15 Class B；RoHS；
Warranty	Whole device for 1 year(Accessories not included)
